description: Exports a Claude Code session as a clean, readable markdown/text transcript.

evals.name: Export a session as markdown
evals.prompt: Export this session as a clean markdown transcript.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current session, runs export_transcript with --format md, produces a readable markdown transcript.

evals.name: Export without tool calls, as plain text
evals.prompt: Export session 511b9c9b-5288-447f-aab2-8e68d013aa97 as plain text, without any tool call details.
evals.expected_output: Uses --format txt --no-include-tools correctly; output has no tool-call summaries; if written to file, uses an absolute path, never a bare relative filename.
